//: Static site, no build step. English is the default document at / ; Georgian
is a plain subdirectory at /ka/ . Nothing here negotiates language: Vercel
does no Accept-Language redirect for static output, so every visitor lands
on English and reaches Georgian only via the nav switch. Keep it that way.
trailingSlash matches the canonical urls exactly (/ and /ka/), so /ka gets a
308 to /ka/ instead of becoming a second url for the same document.
cleanUrls does the same job for /index.html -> / .
The only cache override is the Georgian font: its filename carries the face
version (v48), so a year of immutable caching can never serve a stale file.
Everything else keeps Vercel's revalidate-by-default, which is what the
?v= query strings on styles.css / script.js already rely on.
